scenes.title: A message today. A moment to come back to.
scenes.narration: This is Time Capsule: a Twitch chat experience that saves predictions now and reveals them together on a future stream. This walkthrough uses your real build screenshots, from the first server to the complete demo.
bullets: Streamer, viewer, moderator and OBS flows

captions.text: This is Time Capsule a Twitch chat experience that saves predictions now and
reveals them together on a future stream This walkthrough uses your real build
screenshots from the first server to the complete demo

scenes.title: Start the local app
scenes.narration: Phase one starts in the time capsule project inside WSL. Use Linux Node and npm, install the dependencies, and start the development server. Keep that terminal running while using the dashboard or OBS overlay.
scenes.code:
cd ~/hackathon_projects/time-capsule
export PATH="$PWD/.tools/node/bin:$PATH"
npm ci
npm run dev

captions.text: Phase one starts in the time capsule project inside WSL Use Linux Node
and npm install the dependencies and start the development server Keep that
terminal running while using the dashboard or OBS overlay

scenes.title: Confirm the foundation
scenes.narration: Open localhost, port three thousand, slash health. An okay response confirms the server and SQLite database are available. The current build reports phase eight. Tests, type checking, lint, and build checks verify the foundation and later phases.

captions.text: Open localhost port three thousand slash health An okay response confirms the
server and SQLite database are available The current build reports phase eight
Tests type checking lint and build checks verify the foundation and later phases

scenes.title: Register the Twitch application
scenes.narration: In the Twitch Developer Console, register a confidential Chat Bot application. Set the callback to localhost, port three thousand, slash auth slash callback, exactly. Put the client credentials in the local environment file, then restart the app.

captions.text: In the Twitch Developer Console register a confidential Chat Bot application Set
the callback to localhost port three thousand slash auth slash callback exactly Put
the client credentials in the local environment file then restart the app.

scenes.title: Connect your streamer account
scenes.narration: Open the private dashboard link printed by the server and connect the streamer account. Your screenshot confirms romilg16 is connected and ready to moderate. One account is enough; a separate bot is optional and must be a channel moderator.

captions.text: Open the private dashboard link printed by the server and connect the streamer
account Your screenshot confirms romilg16 is connected and ready to moderate One
account is enough a separate bot is optional and must be a channel
moderator

scenes.title: Listen to live channel events
scenes.narration: Phase three connects Twitch EventSub and live dashboard updates. Your screenshot shows EventSub connected and a received chat event. This confirms messages can travel from Twitch into the local application, even while the channel is offline.

captions.text: Phase three connects Twitch EventSub and live dashboard updates Your screenshot
shows EventSub connected and a received chat event This confirms messages can
travel from Twitch into the local application even while the channel is offline

scenes.title: Send a viewer message
scenes.narration: From a second Twitch account, open the streamer channel and send a simple message. Here, romil100 sends hi in romilg16’s chat. Match it with the dashboard event to check the correct channel and viewer identity.
bullets: Match the message with the event log

captions.text: From a second Twitch account open the streamer channel and send a simple

scenes.title: Check the capsule command
scenes.narration: Now send exclamation capsule. With no capsule accepting messages, the bot replies that no capsule is open for sealing. That is the correct response and verifies both command handling and outbound chat before creating a capsule.
bullets: Bot replies in the same channel
No active capsule is an expected state

captions.text: Now send exclamation capsule With no capsule accepting messages the bot replies
that no capsule is open for sealing That is the correct response and

scenes.title: Choose a capsule title and limits
scenes.narration: Phase four adds capsule creation and sealing. Give the capsule a clear title, choose its opening condition, and set viewer limits. This example uses Test predictions, three messages per viewer, and a maximum length of two hundred and eighty characters.

captions.text: Phase four adds capsule creation and sealing Give the capsule a clear title
choose its opening condition and set viewer limits This example uses Test
predictions three messages per viewer and a maximum length of two hundred and
eighty characters

scenes.title: Create the capsule
scenes.narration: Click Create capsule. The new card should show Sealing and a sealed-message count. Only one capsule accepts new seals at a time. Lock or archive that capsule before creating another; locked capsules preserve their existing messages.
bullets: Public link is separate from the dashboard
One capsule collects seals at a time

captions.text: Click Create capsule The new card should show Sealing and a sealed-message count
Only one capsule accepts new seals at a time Lock or archive that
capsule before creating another locked capsules preserve their existing messages

scenes.title: Seal from another account
scenes.narration: From the viewer account, send exclamation seal followed by a prediction. The app saves and numbers it, attempts to delete the original chat message, and sends a receipt. Your screenshot shows message one sealed and the viewer message removed.
bullets: !seal I predict we will win the next round

captions.text: From the viewer account send exclamation seal followed by a prediction The app
saves and numbers it attempts to delete the original chat message and sends
a receipt Your screenshot shows message one sealed and the viewer message removed

scenes.title: Inspect the public capsule page
scenes.narration: The public page shows the title, opening condition, sealed count, and instructions for viewers. It does not show private message contents. Validation also enforces message length, blocked words, cooldowns, and the configured per-viewer limit.

captions.text: The public page shows the title opening condition sealed count and instructions for
viewers It does not show private message contents Validation also enforces message
length blocked words cooldowns and the configured per-viewer limit

scenes.title: A ready capsule still waits for a live stream
scenes.narration: Phase five adds automatic opening conditions and manual controls. Open now can override the chosen condition, but opening still requires a live stream. Your offline screenshot correctly shows Ready, waiting for the next live stream.
bullets: Manual opening respects the live gate
Settling delay runs once the stream is live

captions.text: Phase five adds automatic opening conditions and manual controls Open now can
override the chosen condition but opening still requires a live stream Your offline
screenshot correctly shows Ready waiting for the next live stream

scenes.title: Postpone without losing the seals
scenes.narration: Postpone delays the opening by ten minutes while preserving the capsule’s messages and original condition. The dashboard displays the new deadline. The live-stream requirement still applies, so an offline channel does not reveal anything accidentally.
bullets: Wait for the deadline and a live stream

captions.text: Postpone delays the opening by ten minutes while preserving the capsule’s messages
and original condition The dashboard displays the new deadline The live-stream
requirement still applies so an offline channel does not reveal anything
accidentally

scenes.title: Use the right opening condition
scenes.narration: The four opening choices are manual, a date, a follower goal, or the first stream in a selected category. Your GTA 6 capsule was configured for Grand Theft Auto Three. The displayed category, rather than the title, controls this trigger.
bullets: Category matching uses the category ID
Title and opening category are independent

captions.text: The four opening choices are manual a date a follower goal or the
first stream in a selected category Your GTA 6 capsule was configured for
Grand Theft Auto Three The displayed category rather than the title controls this
trigger

scenes.title: Archive is a different action
scenes.narration: Archiving preserves existing seals and stops that capsule’s normal workflow. In your screenshot, Test predictions is archived while GTA 6 is still sealing. Archiving a capsule does not start a Twitch broadcast; streaming is controlled separately in OBS.
bullets: Another capsule may still be SEALING
OBS starts the actual Twitch stream

captions.text: Archiving preserves existing seals and stops that capsule’s normal workflow In your
screenshot Test predictions is archived while GTA 6 is still sealing Archiving a
capsule does not start a Twitch broadcast streaming is controlled separately in OBS

scenes.title: Connect OBS to Twitch
scenes.narration: In OBS Settings, open Stream and choose Twitch. Connect the streamer account and keep the recommended automatic server. Your screenshot shows the account connected. Leave bandwidth test mode off when the goal is a real live test.

captions.text: In OBS Settings open Stream and choose Twitch Connect the streamer account and
keep the recommended automatic server Your screenshot shows the account connected
Leave bandwidth test mode off when the goal is a real live test

scenes.title: Check Twitch Stream Manager
scenes.narration: Open Twitch Stream Manager for romilg16 to monitor the broadcast. Before OBS starts transmitting, Offline is expected. The stream preview, chat, activity feed, and stream information help confirm that OBS is using the intended channel.

captions.text: Open Twitch Stream Manager for romilg16 to monitor the broadcast Before OBS starts
transmitting Offline is expected The stream preview chat activity feed and stream
information help confirm that OBS is using the intended channel

scenes.title: Keep the local dashboard running
scenes.narration: Keep the Time Capsule server and dashboard open during the test. The opening checks show the live state, follower count, and category. This screenshot is still offline, so the capsule is waiting even though opening controls are visible.

captions.text: Keep the Time Capsule server and dashboard open during the test The opening
checks show the live state follower count and category This screenshot is still

scenes.title: Set stream information
scenes.narration: In OBS Stream Information, enter a title such as Time Capsule test and select the category required by your capsule. Click Done to save. A stream title describes the broadcast; the category is a separate field used by the category trigger.
bullets: Click Done to save stream information

captions.text: In OBS Stream Information enter a title such as Time Capsule test and
select the category required by your capsule Click Done to save A stream
title describes the broadcast the category is a separate field used by the
category trigger

scenes.title: Choose accurate stream labels
scenes.narration: The Rerun checkbox is for previously recorded broadcasts. Branded Content applies when that stream actually includes the commercial relationships described by Twitch. Choose labels that match your broadcast; a mature-game category may add its own locked content label.

captions.text: The Rerun checkbox is for previously recorded broadcasts Branded Content applies
when that stream actually includes the commercial relationships described by Twitch
Choose labels that match your broadcast a mature-game category may add its own
locked content label

scenes.title: Start the broadcast in OBS
scenes.narration: After saving stream information, use Start Streaming in the OBS Controls panel. Your next screenshot shows Stop Streaming, confirming OBS started sending. Watch the status bar and check Stream Manager for a live broadcast.

captions.text: After saving stream information use Start Streaming in the OBS Controls panel Your
next screenshot shows Stop Streaming confirming OBS started sending Watch the
status bar and check Stream Manager for a live broadcast

scenes.title: A black preview needs a source
scenes.narration: A black stream does not mean you must play a game. OBS needs a visible source to capture. Your Twitch screenshot shows a live but black preview, with an unstable connection indicator. Source visibility and connection stability are separate checks.
bullets: A game is optional for this test

captions.text: A black stream does not mean you must play a game OBS needs
a visible source to capture Your Twitch screenshot shows a live but black
preview with an unstable connection indicator Source visibility and connection
stability are separate checks

scenes.title: Add Window Capture
scenes.narration: Use the plus button under Sources and add Window Capture. Select a safe window, such as a terminal without credentials, and fit it to the canvas. Your OBS screenshot shows the terminal capture active while the camera source is hidden.
bullets: Fit the source to the canvas

captions.text: Use the plus button under Sources and add Window Capture Select a safe
window such as a terminal without credentials and fit it to the canvas
Your OBS screenshot shows the terminal capture active while the camera source is
hidden

scenes.title: Confirm the stream receives video
scenes.narration: The Twitch preview now shows the captured terminal, so OBS is sending visible content. Keep the chosen category aligned with the capsule condition, and wait for the opening delay. The app can test this workflow without requiring actual gameplay.
bullets: Wait for the configured opening delay

captions.text: The Twitch preview now shows the captured terminal so OBS is sending visible
content Keep the chosen category aligned with the capsule condition and wait for
the opening delay The app can test this workflow without requiring actual gameplay

scenes.title: An empty ceremony has nothing to reveal
scenes.narration: Phase six adds the opening ceremony and moderation queue. Your first GTA 6 test had zero messages, so Reveal next and auto-reveal were disabled. End ceremony is appropriate after testing an empty queue; the capsule and its decisions remain saved.

captions.text: Phase six adds the opening ceremony and moderation queue Your first GTA 6

is appropriate after testing an empty queue the capsule and its decisions remain

scenes.title: The overlay is a Browser Source
scenes.narration: The Time Capsule overlay is not a built-in OBS dock. Add it as a Browser Source from the Sources panel. Your screenshot still shows only Window Capture and the camera, so the overlay needs its own source above them.
bullets: Place it above the capture sources

captions.text: The Time Capsule overlay is not a built-in OBS dock Add it as
a Browser Source from the Sources panel Your screenshot still shows only Window
Capture and the camera so the overlay needs its own source above them

scenes.title: Copy the private OBS URL
scenes.narration: Scroll to Your OBS overlay in the dashboard and copy its Browser Source URL. Use the overlay link, not the dashboard or public page. The monitor’s checkerboard represents transparency. The ten-second preview uses sample cards and does not change your capsules.
bullets: Copy OBS URL from the dashboard
Keep the private URL out of broadcasts

captions.text: Scroll to Your OBS overlay in the dashboard and copy its Browser Source
URL Use the overlay link not the dashboard or public page The monitor’s

scenes.title: Configure the Browser Source
scenes.narration: Paste the complete overlay URL into the OBS Browser Source. Set the width to nineteen twenty and the height to ten eighty. The screenshot shows ten seventy-nine, so correct that field. Disable shutting down hidden sources and refreshing the browser when the scene becomes active.
bullets: Paste the complete private overlay URL
Keep the source alive between scenes

seventy-nine so correct that field Disable shutting down hidden sources and
refreshing the browser when the scene becomes active

scenes.title: A transparent idle overlay is expected
scenes.narration: You do not need to open the overlay in a separate browser first. OBS loads it directly. Outside a ceremony or preview, it is intentionally empty and transparent. With every background source hidden, that transparent canvas looks black.

captions.text: You do not need to open the overlay in a separate browser first

scenes.title: Approve before revealing
scenes.narration: Once a capsule opens, review its private moderation queue. Approve messages you want to show and reject anything unsuitable. This screenshot has one approved message and no pending messages, so the Pending filter looks empty. Change the filter to inspect approved entries.
bullets: Reveal next or press N outside a field

captions.text: Once a capsule opens review its private moderation queue Approve messages you want
to show and reject anything unsuitable This screenshot has one approved message and
no pending messages so the Pending filter looks empty Change the filter to
inspect approved entries

scenes.title: Control the opening ceremony
scenes.narration: Use Reveal next for one approved card, or Start auto-reveal for timed progression. Press N only when you are not typing into a field. Overlay settings control card side, size, and interval. End ceremony clears the cards and preserves the review history.
bullets: Card side, size and reveal interval
scenes.code:
SEALED
  ↓ opening condition + live stream
PRIVATE MODERATION QUEUE
  ↓ approve
REVEAL ON OBS
  ↓ end ceremony
EMPTY, TRANSPARENT OVERLAY

captions.text: Use Reveal next for one approved card or Start auto-reveal for timed progression
Press N only when you are not typing into a field Overlay settings
control card side size and interval End ceremony clears the cards and preserves
the review history

scenes.narration: Phase seven recognizes predictions that come true. Create a new capsule called Prophet VIP Test, choose a manual opening for testing, and enable Reward Prophets with VIP if you want to test the role reward. This example uses thirty days.

scenes.title: Send the prediction as a viewer
scenes.narration: From the separate viewer account, send exclamation seal followed by the prediction. Here, romil100’s message is removed and the bot confirms sealed message one. Broadcaster and moderator messages cannot always be hidden, which is why a normal viewer account is useful.
bullets: Wait for the numbered bot receipt

captions.text: From the separate viewer account send exclamation seal followed by the prediction

scenes.title: Open the test capsule while live
scenes.narration: With the stream live, click Open now and wait through the delay and opening animation. The capsule changes to Opening and directs you to the ceremony controls. Approve the saved prediction, then reveal it before trying to mark it true.

captions.text: With the stream live click Open now and wait through the delay and

scenes.title: Mark a revealed prediction true
scenes.narration: In Prophets, mark the revealed prediction Came true only when it actually happened. This saves the recognition, adds the Prophet badge and Came True stamp to the overlay, and attempts the optional reward. Your OBS screenshot shows the recognition working.

captions.text: In Prophets mark the revealed prediction Came true only when it actually happened

scenes.title: Confirm the chat announcement
scenes.narration: The bot also announces the Prophet in Twitch chat. Your screenshot confirms romil100’s prediction came true. The announcement and overlay recognition are separate from VIP eligibility, so those can succeed even when Twitch refuses a role reward.

captions.text: The bot also announces the Prophet in Twitch chat Your screenshot confirms
romil100’s prediction came true The announcement and overlay recognition are
separate from VIP eligibility so those can succeed even when Twitch refuses a

scenes.title: If the overlay vanishes, check the eye icon
scenes.narration: This OBS screenshot shows the Browser Source hidden while Window Capture is visible. Click the crossed-out eye beside Browser to show it, and keep it above the capture source. A working overlay cannot appear in the broadcast while its source is hidden.
bullets: Keep the capture source visible below

captions.text: This OBS screenshot shows the Browser Source hidden while Window Capture is visible
Click the crossed-out eye beside Browser to show it and keep it above
the capture source A working overlay cannot appear in the broadcast while its
source is hidden

scenes.title: Read the real VIP result honestly
scenes.narration: The real Twitch test returned No free VIP slots. The prediction still became a Prophet and the chat announcement succeeded, but VIP was not granted. Free a slot if the channel is eligible, then use Retry VIP. Never treat this error as a successful grant.
bullets: Real test: no free VIP slots
Resolve the issue, then Retry VIP

scenes.title: End the ceremony and preserve the result
scenes.narration: End ceremony returns the overlay to empty and transparent. Your dashboard keeps the prediction, recognition, and VIP error for review. The app checks reward expiry at startup and hourly, and only removes temporary VIP roles it owns; existing VIPs are preserved.
bullets: Owned VIP rewards expire; existing VIPs remain

captions.text: End ceremony returns the overlay to empty and transparent Your dashboard keeps the

startup and hourly and only removes temporary VIP roles it owns existing VIPs
are preserved

scenes.narration: Open the capsule’s public page after the ceremony. Your screenshot shows romil100 on the Wall of Prophets with one prediction that came true. The public view shows display names and counts, while private message contents and reward-management details remain in the dashboard.
bullets: No private message text on the public page

scenes.title: Try it without a Twitch account
scenes.narration: Phase eight adds a completely separate account-free demo. Run npm run demo and open the printed URL. It uses fictional Twitch accounts, fresh demo storage, and fake messages and VIP roles. Your real capsule database and connected account are not used.

scenes.title: Play the full ninety-second story
scenes.narration: Click Play full story. Twenty sample viewers seal predictions, a week of simulated time passes, the stream goes live, and the category changes. The production trigger and ceremony services open the capsule, reveal three approved highlights, and award one fake VIP.
bullets: One Came true → fake VIP → clear overlay

scenes.title: Verify EventSub with the Twitch CLI
scenes.narration: For a separate socket test, start the Twitch CLI mock WebSocket server, then run npm run test colon CLI. Trigger a version two channel update for fictional broadcaster ten thousand and one. The client should report the matching category notification. This does not contact your real channel.
scenes.code:
twitch event websocket start-server --require-subscription

npm run test:cli

twitch event trigger channel.update \
  --transport=websocket --version=2 \
  --to-user=10001 --game-id=900000001 \
  --item-name="Grand Theft Auto VI"

captions.text: For a separate socket test start the Twitch CLI mock WebSocket server then

category notification This does not contact your real channel

scenes.title: From the first server to the full story
scenes.narration: All eight completed phases are covered: the server, authentication, live events, sealing, opening triggers, OBS ceremonies, Prophet rewards, and the isolated demo. The build passed one hundred and ninety-three tests, type checking, lint, and compilation. Phase nine remains future polish.
bullets: Seal today. Reveal when it matters.

04  Capsules + seals  08  Account-free demo
